name: Frontage
summary: Crisp off-white trade-services site with an inset photo hero card, a floating quote picker and one hit of safety yellow on every CTA.

fonts.pairing: single grotesk family; medium 500 display with tight -0.045em tracking, regular 400 for paragraphs

signature: hero photo inset 6px into a rounded card with a glass pill nav floating over it and a white selection-chip quote widget docked bottom right
before/after drag sliders in a 3-up grid
services cards with a frosted tag pill on the photo and an icon meta row under a hairline
imagery: bright documentary photos of crews and clean house exteriors, one dusk shot for the plan card
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 40px side padding, 112px section padding, 56px header-to-grid gap, 3-column cards with 20px gutters
